scope: SDevice-only frozen-state minority-hole and Poisson-floor causal perturbation
claim_policy: A frozen hole or electron replacement is a directional perturbation, not a self-consistent alternative solution.
The terminal-current functional gives the exact frozen direct response; the adjoint prediction is first order only.
A frozen psi-only perturbation can have zero direct terminal-current response while retaining an indirect self-consistent response through the Poisson-QFP cross blocks.
Poisson-only block steps diagnose the residual floor and do not change production solver defaults.
No default BGN, SRH, mobility, contact, SG, or convergence setting may be changed from this audit alone.
